**Answer**

The production company that made **_A Cosmic Christmas_** is **Nelvana Ltd.**  
Nelvana’s headquarters are in **Toronto, Ontario, Canada**.

In Toronto today, the main departure point for Greyhound (and other inter‑city coach) services is the **Toronto Union Station Bus Terminal** – the hub that has carried Greyhound shuttles for most of the city’s history.

| Location | Address | Notes |
|----------|---------|-------|
| **Union Station Bus Terminal** | **81 Bay Street, Toronto, ON M5J 2X8** | Current primary Greyhound departure point from Toronto.  Greyhound Canada (the operator that served Toronto) was still using this terminal up until its final shutdown of Canadian operations in 2021. |
| **Former Greyhound Toronto Terminal** (closed 2012) | **3500 Yonge Street, Toronto, ON M5S 1Y3** | This was the company’s Canada‑wide terminal before it was closed and relocated.  It was the main bus drop‑off for Greyhound in Toronto until the 2012 closure. |

So, in the city where Nelvana’s headquarters sit, Greyhound buses now leave from the Toronto Union Station Bus Terminal at 81 Bay Street.
